spaceInvaders.title: Space Invaders Game
spaceInvaders.description: Shun Ren — Singapore-based security & software engineer. Projects, skills, and background.
paragraphs: I learnt a lot from this project. It was one of the first times I used object-oriented programming. The change in thought processes from procedural programming to object-oriented programming was a bit jarring at first but, after I got used to it did I realise how OOP was a lot more useful than procedural programming especially when all I had to do to change one attribute was to go to its respective file.

spotifyTimeMachine.title: Spotify Time Machine Script
spotifyTimeMachine.description: Shun Ren — Singapore-based security & software engineer. Projects, skills, and background.
paragraphs: This was my first time utilising an API in conjuction with web scraping in order to analyse and process data. Learning and reading the documentation of an external library, Spotipy, I found out that I was able to access various features of Spotify's client, including the searching of songs and creation of playlists. Overall it was an enlightening experience.
